sloka: गात्रेषु वलय: प्राप्ता: श्वेताश्चैव शिरोरुहा: ।जरया पुरुषो जीर्ण: किं हि कृत्वा प्रभावयेत् ॥ २.१०५.२३॥
transliteration: gātreṣu valaya: prāptā: śvetāścaiva śiroruhā: ।jarayā puruṣo jīrṇa: kiṁ hi kṛtvā prabhāvayet ॥ 2.105.23॥

translations.english: Wrinkels form on the body and hair turns grey in old age. In this way, decayed with age, what can a man do to have control over death.
